findings.claim: the #2206/#2207 mitigation never reaches the MP path
findings.evidence: save_unfull_chunk consumed at integration/vllm/vllm_v1_adapter.py:562-567 and its chunk mask at 822-827; the string is absent from lmcache_mp_connector.py in our wheel, in upstream v0.5.2 and in upstream dev

findings.claim: the MP path's guard is the skip_first_n_tokens contract, unchanged upstream
findings.evidence: skip_first_n_tokens = num_vllm_hit_tokens - start_token_idx with start_token_idx = num_vllm_hit_tokens // chunk * chunk at lmcache_mp_connector.py:452-456,516 (ours and upstream v0.5.2); same expressions moved to lmcache_mp_metadata.py:323 in upstream dev; version-pinned variants compute it block-granularly (lmcache_mp_connector_0180.py:398, _0201.py:395)

findings.claim: our damage locus is the tail of the retrieve range, not the APC-overlap head #2206 describes
findings.evidence: skip region protects [start_token_idx, num_vllm_hit_tokens) at the head of [start_token_idx, end_token_idx); our rule fires on [hit_tokens-1600, hit_tokens), the last chunk written, with end_token_idx chunk-aligned by the assert at lmcache_mp_connector.py:458
findings.consequence: #2206's published mechanism does not explain our signature; no root cause asserted

findings.claim: config default in the pinned wheel is not the culprit
findings.evidence: v1/config.py:381-385 declares save_unfull_chunk default False; the only force-to-True paths are enable_blending (v1/config.py:705-711) and PD mode (750-766), neither enabled in our arms
